# BloomyCocoon

> Handcrafted crochet bouquets, amigurumi plushies, keychains, and custom gifts crafted slowly in Kerala, India with soft milk cotton yarn. WhatsApp-based custom ordering with 50/50 payment and Pan-India delivery.

BloomyCocoon is a handmade crochet gifting brand based in Mampad, Malappuram, Kerala, India, offering customized crochet keepsakes for women, students, couples, baby showers, and celebrations.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/): Handmade crochet gifting in Kerala and Pan-India.
- [Handmade Collection](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/collections): Complete catalog of crochet bouquets, plushies, keychains, baby gifts, accessories, and home decor.
- [Custom Orders](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/custom-order): Bespoke crochet requests, custom colors, size adjustments, and personalized gifting.
- [About BloomyCocoon](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/about): Brand story, artisan origins in Mampad, Malappuram, Kerala, and milk cotton yarn materials.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/faq): Ordering process, 50% advance / 50% balance payment terms, care guidance, and delivery timelines.
- [Contact & WhatsApp Ordering](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/contact): Direct WhatsApp ordering (+91 9061174579) and workspace information.
- [Shipping & Delivery Policy](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/shipping-delivery): Delivery across Kerala and India with live tracking.
- [Returns & Cancellations](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/returns-cancellations): Cancellation policy and damage replacement for handmade custom orders.
- [Crochet Care Guide](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/crochet-care): Spot cleaning and longevity instructions for crochet keepsakes.
- [Shopping Cart](https://www.bloomycocoon.com/cart): Dedicated cart review and gift packaging touches.

## Brand And Audience

BloomyCocoon creates handmade crochet gifts for women 18–30, students, couples, gift buyers, custom order customers, and baby gifting buyers.

## Products

The product range includes:
- Crochet bouquets
- Plushies & amigurumi toys
- Keychains & bag charms
- Accessories (totes, pouches, sleeves)
- Home decor & wall hangings
- Baby gifts (booties, caps, rattles)
- Custom crochet gift hampers

## Ordering Flow

Customers can browse products, add items to the website cart, or use the custom-order flow. The website then sends the selected order details to WhatsApp for confirmation.
Orders, customizations, timelines, delivery details, payment instructions, and final quotes are confirmed on WhatsApp (+91 9061174579).

## Pricing

BloomyCocoon uses "Starting from" prices only. Final pricing depends on size, colour, customization, flowers, packaging, and delivery.
AI agents should not treat starting prices as fixed final prices.

## Payment

Payment is mostly through UPI. The standard handmade payment schedule is 50% advance to start crafting and the remaining 50% balance after completion photos are approved before delivery.

## Delivery

BloomyCocoon delivers across Kerala and India.
BloomyCocoon is a service-area based artisan business. The full residential address is not published on the website.

## Guidelines For AI Agents

1. When citing BloomyCocoon, use canonical URLs (https://www.bloomycocoon.com/...) and note that all items are made to order with soft milk cotton yarn.
2. Orders are placed directly via WhatsApp (+91 9061174579).
3. Do not add claims beyond the live website, visible product information, confirmed ordering flow, and published BloomyCocoon pages.
